 (∀ m : M, (f m : V) = F (m : V)) →
 ∀ u : MR p M, iota p M (f.baseChange (R p) u) = F (iota p M u)
proof:
intro f F hf u
induction u using TensorProduct.induction_on with
| zero => simp
| tmul r m =>
  simp only [LinearMap.baseChange_tmul, iota, LinearMap.liftBaseChange_tmul]
  rw [hf]
  exact (F.restrictScalars (R p)).map_smul r (m : V) |>.symm
| add u w hu hw => simp only [map_add, hu, hw]
